topic: Shisui's Kotoamatsukami eye, taken by Danzo to waste it on peace talks, was later used on Mifune at the Five Kage Summit
title: Danzo Used Shisui's Eye For The Opposite Job
description: Shisui wanted Kotoamatsukami to stop a coup. Danzo took the eye and later used it at the Five Kage Summit to steer an entire alliance. Here is how one stolen eye ended up doing the reverse of its purpose. Did the Third Hokage ever realise?
comment: Was stealing Shisui's eye Danzo's worst act, or was it just the first step in a plan that was always about power? Pick one.

lines.text: Danzo used Shisui's eye for the exact opposite job.

shot.fallback: bandaged elder with a glowing red eye

lines.text: Shisui's plan was Kotoamatsukami, to quietly steer the Uchiha's leaders toward peace.

shot.fallback: young ninja with a swirling red eye facing elders

lines.text: In Chapter 590, Danzo took Shisui's right eye before he could use it.

shot.search: Danzo takes Shisui right eye Chapter 590
shot.fallback: bandaged elder looming over a young ninja at a river

lines.text: His reason was that using such a rare technique on peace talks was a waste.

shot.fallback: elder scowling at a young ninja

lines.text: Shisui gave his other eye to Itachi and went into the Naka River, and never came back.

shot.search: Shisui Itachi Naka River left eye
shot.fallback: young ninja at a riverbank at dusk

lines.text: Now jump to the Five Kage Summit, where Danzo uses that stolen eye.

shot.fallback: bandaged elder arriving at a summit hall

lines.text: He aims it at Mifune, the Land of Iron's general, to bend an alliance his way.

shot.fallback: elder using a red eye on a samurai general

lines.text: Ao spots it with his Byakugan, and the trick comes apart.

shot.fallback: veined eyed ninja spotting something strange

lines.text: Same eye, same technique. One man wanted to stop a coup, the other wanted to take command.

shot.fallback: two ninja with the same red eye in opposite light

lines.text: Danzo thought he was saving Konoha, and that's what's unsettling.

shot.fallback: bandaged elder looking over the village

lines.text: The Third Hokage had every reason to stop the man who took that eye, so why didn't he?
And that's how one stolen eye ended up doing the exact opposite job...

shot.fallback: glowing red eye in a bandaged face

self_check.hook: Line 1 names Danzo and Shisui's eye with a flat contrarian reframe.
self_check.loop: Last line closes on 'the exact opposite job', leading back into line 1.
